public_rationale: The inference that revenue had stalled around $13 billion is contradicted under the stated reading. Microsoft's later year-over-year disclosure implies a March 2025 run rate of approximately $16.6 billion, materially above $13 billion. The January announcement also described an achieved run rate, not a full-year projection. This verdict does not establish that Microsoft publicly updated the absolute figure before the post.
limitations: The verdict addresses the normalized stall proposition; the separate disclosure assertion is not disproved.
Zitron presented stagnation as an inference, not a certainty.
The calculation relies on the comparability implicit in Microsoft's year-over-year disclosure.
The precise historical value is affected by rounding.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Microsoft's AI revenue appears to have stalled around a $13 billion annual projection.

statement.excerpt: Microsoft has not updated its annualized revenue publicly since January, when they said it was projected to be $13 billion this year, suggesting it’s stalled.

from_speaker: has not updated its annualized revenue publicly since January
projected to be $13 billion this year
our_interpretation: Assess the normalized proposition as an inference that Microsoft's AI business had stopped growing materially beyond approximately $13 billion in annualized revenue.
The latest completed quarter with public results before the post was January through March 2025; use that quarter for the ongoing revenue state.
Assess the absence-of-disclosure assertion separately over January through June 30. Revenue growth does not itself prove that an updated figure was publicly announced during that interval.
'Suggesting' makes the stall inference tentative. It is not a forecast that revenue would remain flat indefinitely.
Use Microsoft's company-reported AI revenue run rate, not realized annual revenue or Azure's total revenue.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable company-reported figures establish that the AI revenue run rate remained approximately $13 billion through the target quarter, alongside a documented absence of a public update before the post.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable figures establish a materially higher AI revenue run rate during the target quarter, contradicting the stall inference; alternatively, a dated pre-publication update contradicts the disclosure assertion.
